subject.title: fix (Computer Use) Stabilize Codex Computer Use readiness

question: Should enabled Codex Computer Use fail closed by default on the live list_apps readiness probe while adding the eight new Computer Use operational config/env knobs?
rationale: The code is coherent and proof-backed, but config/default additions and fail-closed setup behavior are compatibility-sensitive product choices under AGENTS.md, so automation should not infer maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept strict readiness
options.body: Accept the current fail-closed default and config surface as the desired Computer Use behavior after the docs qualifier is fixed.

options.title: Preserve fallback by default
options.body: Require fallbackOnFailure or a separate strict mode to preserve existing enabled-user startup behavior unless users opt into fail-closed readiness.

options.title: Narrow the config surface
options.body: Ask the author to collapse or defer some of the new operational knobs before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept strict readiness
recommendation.body: Accept the current fail-closed default and config surface as the desired Computer Use behavior after the docs qualifier is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent current-main history across the Codex app-server config and lifecycle paths that determine the compatibility decision.
